title: Account Executive
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, and TDS compliance.
 Prepare and review financial statements (Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Statement) on a monthly basis.
 Ensure timely submission of tax returns (GST Annual Returns) and other statutory filings.
 Maintain accurate records in Tally ERP software.
 Provide support to senior management on accounting-related matters.

Key Skills: TDS,GST,Tally,Tally ERP,Bank Reconciliation,ERP,Reconciliation,Accounting
